notes.title: Update 1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey to all Louma players out there

We have now finished the first update so many of the problems you mentioned should be fixed, if your bugs are not there yet please have a look at our first post where we have listed our updates in a roadmap, if there is still something missing, please write it in the community tab and we will include it in the next patches.

Changelog


 Texts were displayed backwards in between
 After finishing the boss and the credits, you can now return directly to the main menu
 The lowest floor now works again in the main menu
 When selecting the class, you can now return to the main menu from there
 We have fixed all reported spelling mistakes
 You now have to address NPCs yourself
 Weapons are no longer saved after death


This was our first update, hopefully we could fix a lot of things for you
Next up is the controller support and the keyboard mappings so that you can set them yourself.

We wish you continued fun with Louma
Robin Hoffmann (CEO of DreamStudios)

notes.title: Roadmap 🥳
notes.content:
Hey to all the Louma players out there.

First of all, thank you to everyone who has supported us in our journey, every player, every Steam review and every criticism we've received, it's only thanks to you that we can keep improving.

It's been months now, so let me explain briefly on behalf of DreamStudios.

Louma was further developed by us DreamStudios, the former studio Thetra had given us their game, which turned out to be a small prototype at that point, we changed many bugs, new content, more languages and much more. Anyone who knows Dreamstudios will know that we are a young team of developers who have made it our mission to develop cool games by gamers for gamers and that is exactly what we do with love.
Our game projects Bearskull and Neospace have taken us a lot of time, which is why nothing has come of them so far.

But we are not a development studio that leaves games lying around, we have taken all your criticism, suggestions and frustrating criticism regarding the controls and the poor controller support to heart.

But now I would like to get to the point.
We have made a long list of bugs, quality of life updates and content requests.
And we are going to implement these, with a total of 5 updates currently planned.
If we receive further feedback, we will of course take this into account.


Roadmap

Update 1 - Hotfix

 texts are displayed backwards in between
 After finishing the boss and the credits you cannot get back to the main menu
 The lowest floor does not work in the main menu
 Choose a class and return to the main menu from there
 Spelling mistake
 NPC cannot be addressed by yourself
 Weapons are still saved after death


Update 2 - Quality of Life


 Full controller support
 Completely new pause menu
 Can change keyboard mappings yourself
 Beauty bug in the map


Update 3 - Content


 New enemy types
 New levels with a wave mode
 New player class
 New Achievements


Update 4 - Content


 New levels
 An additional boss
 Feature for long-term motivation
 New achievements


Update 5 - Porting


 Mobile port


These are our current plans for the future of Louma.
All of these updates will be completely FREE for you to play.

Therefore we would be very happy if you would leave us a Steam review and check out our Discord

Thank you on behalf of DreamStudios

Robin Hoffmann - CEO of DreamStudios
